breadcrumbs.note: Round 1 critic: contract PASS, bar FAIL — only global.css + tokens.ts used the CSS vars; 14 feature CSS files had 576 hardcoded hex colors and 0 var(--pa-*) uses, so the shell/sidebar/composer/views stayed dark in light mode. D1 convert feature CSS, D2 fix shell.css local --glass/--hairline, D3 verify light, D4 no dark regression.

global.css: added --pa-* surface/border/text/accent/semantic/scrollbar/focus/glow vars for dark (:root) and light (:root[data-theme=light]). Added --pa-X-rgb channel vars so alpha variants use rgba(var(--pa-X-rgb), A) — color-mix with transparent blends toward black (wrong for 'color at opacity'), so rgb-channel vars are the correct mechanism.
tokens.ts color values now reference var(--pa-*) so all 128 inline-style consumers switch automatically. textInverse stays literal #0e0e0e (primary button is always white bg + black text).

Python script converted ~700 hardcoded colors across 13 feature CSS files to var(--pa-*) / rgba(var(--pa-X-rgb), A). Hex: #0e0e0e->ink, #f4f4f4->paper, #151515->card, #202020->secondary, #2a2a2a->border, #2c2c2c->border-strong, #111->overlay, #85ed75->green, #9fff8a->green-hover, #f3bc56->amber, #ef4444->danger, #8b7cf6->info, #38bdf8->tool. rgba(244,244,244,X)->rgba(var(--pa-paper-rgb),X) etc. Kept dark scrims (rgba(14,14,14,X) modal backdrops, rgba(0,0,0,X) shadows) dark; inverted translucent panel/glass backgrounds to rgba(var(--pa-ink-rgb),X).

shell.css local --glass/--glass-raised/--glass-soft/--hairline/--hairline-strong now alias the global theme vars (--pa-glass, --pa-card-rgb, --pa-paper-rgb, --pa-line, --pa-line-strong). Main bg gradient + system-bar glass invert via --pa-ink-rgb / --pa-glass.

Converted TS hardcoded colors: core.tsx badge soft tones -> rgba(var(--pa-X-rgb),0.12); ModelSelector/ProvidersPanel SVG strokes -> rgba(var(--pa-paper-rgb),0.45); ModelSelector check stroke -> var(--pa-green-hover); DaemonStatusBanner border -> var(--pa-border); icons.tsx SigmaGlyph defaults -> var(--pa-paper)/var(--pa-green); Sidebar icon color -> var(--pa-green)/rgba(var(--pa-paper-rgb),0.45). Fixed onboarding primary button color var(--pa-ink)->#0e0e0e (white button + black text in both themes).

theme.ts statusWash now returns var(--pa-green-soft)/--pa-amber-soft/--pa-danger-soft/--pa-paper-dim instead of `${hex}22` (string concat on a var() would be invalid CSS). graph.css: .pa-graph .react-flow.dark background-color overridden to var(--pa-ink) so the React Flow canvas follows the theme (colorMode='dark' kept for internal node/edge defaults).

src/design/theme.ts: reactive store — Theme type, resolveTheme (system->matchMedia), applyTheme (sets data-theme + notifies subscribers), subscribeTheme, getTheme. src/hooks/useTheme.ts: reads settings once, subscribes to theme store so GeneralPanel changes re-apply + keep the system matchMedia subscription live. App.tsx calls useTheme(). index.html: inline anti-flash script reads localStorage prime-agent.settings.v1 and sets data-theme before CSS applies.
GeneralPanel theme Select now calls applyTheme(theme) on change (immediate, not just on save).

npx tsc --noEmit -> 0 errors. npx vitest run -> 86/86 pass. npm run build -> success. Dark visual harness (v1-visual-match.py via system Chrome) -> PASS, 0 blockers, 0 console errors. Light theme verified across all views: body rgb(244,244,244), text rgb(14,14,14), 0 white-text-on-light, 0 dark backgrounds. System theme follows OS live (emulateMedia flip re-resolves). Anti-flash: data-theme=light at DOMContentLoaded with seeded localStorage. GeneralPanel Select applies immediately.
